record_scope_reconstruction: Lithuania’s September11,2023 rule barred ordinary import of Russia-registered cars through Lithuanian border customs posts, including temporary import regardless of owner/driver citizenship. Qualified Kaliningrad transit remained possible with the owner present, simplified transit document and maximum24-hour transit. This passenger-vehicle road rule is distinct from2022 rail-cargo restrictions and does not establish closure of all Lithuania–Russia or Lithuania–Belarus movement.
